blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely strongly on language for describing task information, despite having multimodal inputs. We hypothesize that other modalities in the state space may present opportunities for supplemental task conditioning, which may be particularly relevant in cluttered or otherwise ambiguous scenes. We introduce two tuned models to test this hypothesis: (1) an electrophysiology-conditioned VLA (EC-VLA) that incorporates 8-channel electromyography envelopes as continuous conditioning input concatenated to the proprioceptive vector, and (2) a visually-annotated VLA (VA-VLA) that incorporates visual segmentation annotations to the image inputs. On a cube-selection task evaluated across three participants, EC-VLA matches a language-prompted baseline in uncluttered, in-distribution conditions and substantially outperforms it in cluttered, out-of-distribution scenes. Similarly, VA-VLA shows modest improvements over a language-prompted baseline in in-distribution scenes with substantial improvement in cluttered, out-of-distribution trials. Together, these results provide strong evidence for the potential benefit of task-conditioning beyond language.
blocks.zh: 远景-语言-行动(VLA)模型在描述任务信息时强烈依赖语言,尽管有多模式投入。 我们假设,国家空间中的其他模式可能为补充任务提供机遇,这在杂乱或模棱两可的场景中可能特别相关。 我们引入了两种调制模型来测试这个假说:(1)一个电生学条件的VLA(EC-VLA),将8道电传动信封作为自带向量相接的连续调制输入;(2)一个视觉附加说明的VLA(VA-VLA),将视觉分解说明纳入图像输入. 在三个参与者评价的立方体选择任务中,EC-VLA在不杂乱无章的分布条件下与语言促动的基线相匹配,并在杂乱无章的分布外场景中大大地超过了它。 同样,VA-VLA显示,在分配场景中,与语言引发的基线相比,略有改进,在杂乱无章的、不分配的试验中也有了实质性改进。 这些结果共同有力地证明,除语言外,任务调节可能有好处。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have recently gained significant traction as a means for generalized robotic control, and can serve as a base model to be tuned for a downstream task [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Such tuned policies inherit their high-level state structure from the base model: a low-level proprioceptive vector, one or more camera views, and a task description given as language. The majority of VLA parameters are often initialized from a large language model (LLM), forming the core backbone of the model. At deployment time, language is used to define what the robot needs to accomplish in the environment and is typically given as an up-front command that stays fixed during task execution.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型最近作为通用机器人控制手段获得了显著的牵引力,并可作为下游任务调制的基础模型[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]. 此类调制政策继承了基础模型中高层次的状态结构:低层次自控向量,一个或多个相机视图,以及作为语言给出的任务描述. VLA参数大多由大语言模型(LLM)初始化而来,形成模型的核心主干. 在部署时,语言用来定义机器人在环境中需要完成什么,通常作为任务执行期间保持固定的上前命令给出.

blocks.en: However, as these systems continue to become more capable and take on increasingly complex tasks, there will be times in which language is insufficient as a task-defining condition. Cluttered scenes and nuanced tasks might require detailed explanation that a human would more naturally express with a gesture, picture, or gaze [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,随着这些系统的能力继续增强并承担了日益复杂的任务,有时语言不足以作为确定任务的条件。 拼接的场景和细微的任务可能需要详细解释,人类会更自然地用手势,相片来表达,或凝视[8,9,10].

blocks.en: Fig. 1: An overview of vision-language-action (VLA) model architectures and how we propose to modify the inclusion of task information.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1:概述愿景语言-行动(VLA)模式架构,以及我们提议如何修改任务信息的纳入。

blocks.en: We explore tuning VLAs with tasks defined by continuous conditioning signals incorporated into state modalities beyond text. As shown in Figure 1 , we construct two experiments: one with task conditioning in the proprioceptive vector and one with conditioning in the image modality, with only generic task information given in the text input. We compare these to tuned models that use the more standard descriptive text inputs. We find that these alternative modalities for task conditioning, supplied as continuous state information, generally yield stronger performance than the baseline tuned policies, especially in cluttered scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们探索用连续调制信号确定的任务来调制VLA。 如图1所示,我们构建了两个实验:一个实验在自控矢量中具有任务调节,另一个实验在图像模式中具有条件,只有文本输入中给出的通用任务信息. 我们把这些模型比作调制模型,这些模型使用更标准的描述文本输入. 我们发现,作为连续状态信息提供的这些任务调节的替代方式,一般比基线调整后的政策产生更强的业绩,特别是在杂乱的场景中。

blocks.en: II Background
blocks.zh: 二. 背景情况

blocks.en: II-A Vision Language Action Models
blocks.zh: II-A 远景语言行动模式

blocks.en: In our experiments we utilize SmolVLA [ 6 ] and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 5 ] , which are both action-expert style VLAs that use a flow-matching [ 11 ] head on top of a VLM backbone. This architecture was first introduced in Octo [ 3 ] (using a diffusion policy head) and π 0 \pi_{0} [ 4 ] . It contrasts with earlier autoregressive techniques like OpenVLA [ 2 ] , which output discrete tokens that need to be converted into actions afterwards.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们利用了 SmolVLA [6] 和 \\ 0.5\ pi\ 0.5}, 两者都是动作-专家风格的 VLA 使用流相配 [11] 头顶上 VLM 骨干. 这个架构最早引入于Octo [3] (使用传播政策头)和 \\\\\\\0}[4]. 它与OpenVLA [2]等更早的自相递入技术形成对比,后者输出出需要事后转换为动作的离散符号.

blocks.en: II-B Electrophysiological Signals and Robot Policies
blocks.zh: II-B 地球物理学信号和机器人政策

blocks.en: Many prior works explore shared control between a robotic system and user data collected through electromyography (EMG), (electroencephalogram) EEG, or brain-computer interface (BCI) signals. These inputs provide intent or feedback, often falling in the domain of assistive robotics. Xu et al. [ 12 ] use EEG signals to direct a robotic system towards grasping a target object. Akinola et al. [ 13 ] use EEG as a way for a human to note an incorrect action, a signal which is then used to further improve the policy.
blocks.zh: 许多前作探索机器人系统与通过电磁学(EMG),(电脑图)EEG,或脑-计算机接口(BCI)信号所收集的用户数据之间的共享控制. 这些投入提供了意向或反馈,往往属于辅助机器人领域. 徐等 [12] 使用 EEG 信号引导一个机器人系统来抓取目标对象. 阿基诺拉等. [13] 使用EEG作为人类注意错误行动的方法,这个信号随后被用来进一步改善政策.

blocks.en: More recent and relevant to this work, Lee et al. [ 14 ] combine EEG with an AI copilot, in a similar setup to our first experiment. M4Bench [ 8 ] explored eye tracking and EMG as input modalities in a multirobot pick-and-place problem. The extension by Douglas et al. [ 15 ] integrates EEG, EMG, and eye tracking in a system to control Franka arms in simulated kitchens with a focus on allocating control to either the human or policy. Our EC-VLA model is a robotic policy that directly receives EMG inputs as state information.
blocks.zh: 更近也与这项工作有关,李等. [14]结合EEG和AI副驾驶,在类似我们第一次实验的设置中. M4 Bench [8]在多机器人取地问题中探索了将眼睛跟踪和EMG作为输入模式. 由道格拉斯等扩展. [15]整合了EEG,EMG,和眼睛跟踪系统,在模拟厨房中控制Franka手臂,并专注于将控制分配给人或政策. 我们的EC-VLA模型是一种机器人政策,它直接接收EMG作为状态信息的投入.

blocks.en: II-C Visual Annotations and Robot Policies
blocks.zh: 二-C 视觉说明和机器人政策

blocks.en: Several prior works have examined visual prompting to describe tasks to a robotic policy. KITE [ 16 ] trains a policy that conditions on imagery and keypoints rather than language directly. MOKA [ 17 ] also annotates images with key points, asking a VLM to select among a set of key points to identify which are most useful. RT-Trajectory [ 18 ] uses 2D curves drawn over a scene that roughly depict how a robot should move.
blocks.zh: 之前的多部作品研究了视觉提示,以描述机器人政策的任务. KITE [16] 培训一项以图像和关键点而不是语言为条件的政策。 MOKA [17] 也用关键点来注释图像,请 VLM 在一组关键点中选择,以识别哪些最有用. RT-Trajectory [18] 使用从一个场景上画出2D曲线,大致描绘出机器人应该如何移动.

blocks.en: Works similar to our second experiment include FOCA [ 19 ] , which uses segmentation masks from RoboCasa at training time to supervise predicted features, and RoboGround [ 20 ] , which uses segmentation-style masks to describe a target object and destination in RoboCasa. RoboGround conditions the policy on these masks and a language instruction, while in this work we explore omitting language when visual prompts are supplied. Also similar is MOO [ 9 ] , which directly describes a target object with a segmentation mask and omits this identity from language inputs to an RT-1 [ 1 ] -style policy. Gaze2Act [ 10 ] includes a human in the loop who provides conditioning signals to help select an object while the text prompt is underspecified. Its human focus aligns well with our first experiment, but its signal is supplied in a manner closer to our second experiment: a human gaze is first translated into a visual mask and then supplied as an image.
blocks.zh: 与我们第二次实验相似的作品有:FOCA [19],在训练时使用从RoboCasa发出的分块口罩来监督所预测的特征;RoboGround [20],使用分块式口罩来描述在RoboCasa的一个目标物体和目的地. RoboGround为这些口罩和语言教学规定了政策条件,而在本作中我们探索在提供视觉提示时省略语言. 同样相类似的是MOO [9],它直接描述了一个带有分解口罩的目标对象,并将这个身份从语言输入中省略到RT-1 [1] - 有风格的政策. Gaze2Act [10] 包括了循环中的人,在文本提示被低估时,提供条件信号来帮助选择一个对象. 它的人类焦点与我们的第一个实验非常吻合,但是它的信号的提供方式更接近我们的第二个实验:一个人类的目光首先被翻译成视觉口罩,然后作为图像提供.

blocks.en: III Methods
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: We conduct experiments that specialize pretrained action-expert VLA models on tasks in which the task specification is provided via continuous conditioning by a modality that augments an underspecified language prompt. We compare these systems against the more standard paradigm of tuning with fully descriptive text prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们进行实验,专门使用经过预先培训的动作专家VLA模型来说明通过连续调制提供任务规格的任务,而这种调制方式会增强未指定语言的快感。 我们比较这些系统与更标准的调和模式,即完全描述文本提示。

blocks.en: For both experiments, we also explore performance in cluttered scenes that are not represented in the training data. We hypothesize that, in cluttered environments, text may fall short of other modalities in its ability to specify a task. We grade all trials using a task-completion score that assigns partial credit to failures in four stages, adapted from MolmoAct [ 7 ] . Scoring and criteria for this partial credit scheme are described in Table I .
blocks.zh: 对于这两个实验,我们也探索在训练数据中没有体现的杂乱的场景中的表现. 我们假设,在杂乱的环境中,文本可能无法达到指定任务的其他方式。 我们使用任务完成分数对所有审判进行评分,该分数根据Molmo Act [7] 改编,对四个阶段的失败给予部分评分。 这一部分信贷计划的分红和标准见表一。

blocks.en: III-A Experiment 1: Electrophysiology-Conditioned VLA
blocks.zh: III-A 实验1:弱营养生物学 -- -- 有条件的VLA

blocks.en: III-A 1 EC-VLA Task
blocks.zh: III-A 1 欧共体-VLA任务

blocks.en: In this experiment, we examine replacing the descriptive text task description with a constant underspecified text prompt and an 8-dimensional EMG signal added to the state information. An augmented demonstration consists of d ∼ 𝒟 E ​ C = ( ℓ u , I , q E ​ C , a ) 0 : T d\sim\mathcal{D}_{EC}=(\ell^{u},I,q_{EC},a)_{0:T} , where ℓ u \ell^{u} denotes an underspecified constant text prompt and q E ​ C = [ q ; E ​ M ​ G ] q_{EC}=[q;EMG] is a concatenation of the standard proprioceptive vector and the EMG features. E ​ C EC is used instead of a ​ u ​ g aug to note the specific augmentations for experiment 1, concerning electrophysiological conditioning (EC).
blocks.zh: 在这个实验中,我们研究用不断被忽略的文本提示和添加到状态信息的8维EMG信号来取代描述性文本任务描述. 扩大的演示包括: d 个 D E C = (我,我,我,q E C,a) 0: t\ sim\ mathcal{ D}_{EC} (\ell^{u}, I, q_{EC}, a)}\\\: 0: T},其中我u\ell^{u}表示未指定不变的文本即时和q E C = [q; E M G] q_{EC}= [q;EMG]是标准自旋矢量和EMG特性的调和. 使用EC EC而不是u g aug来说明关于电生理学条件的实验1的具体增强。

blocks.en: We apply the SO-101 arm to a block-grasping task in which four identical cubes are arranged along a linear workspace. The system is tasked with picking a given cube and placing it into a receptacle. A baseline descriptive prompt ℓ \ell describes which cube to grasp, such as ”Pick up the second to the left cube and place it in the box.” , while ℓ u \ell^{u} is simply the constant ”Pick up the cube and place it in the box” .
blocks.zh: 我们用SO-101臂来完成一个块状的编织任务,其中四个相同的立方体按照线性的工作空间排列. 该系统的任务是取出一个特定的立方体并将其放入贮器. 基线描述快取 (l\ell) 描述要抓住的立方体, 例如“ 将第二个立方体放到左侧并放入盒子中 ” , 而 I u\ell\u} 仅仅是“ 把立方体放在盒子中” 的常数 。

blocks.en: Our system runs at 15 Hz and includes two RGB camera views comprising I t I_{t} (one overhead and one wrist-mounted). The actions to the robot a t a_{t} are specified as 6-dimensional vectors describing desired positions for all six degrees of freedom. The baseline q q is a 6-dimensional proprioceptive vector that includes five joint angles and gripper status, and as described above, q E ​ C q_{EC} contains eight additional inputs comprising EMG signals from a supervising human. The EMG input represents intent signals that the human can provide via wrist gestures, guiding the arm to correct left, correct right, or select a block.
blocks.zh: 我们的系统运行在15赫兹,包括两个RGB相机视图,包括It I_{t}(一个是高架,一个是手腕上挂)。 对机器人的动作 a t a_{t} 被指定为六维向量,描述所有六度自由所期望的位置. 基线 q q 是一个6维自转矢量,包括5个联角和夹克状态,如上所述,q E C q EC 含有8个额外输入,包括来自监督人的EMG信号. EMG输入代表了人类通过手腕手势可以提供的意向信号,引导臂向左,右,或选择一个块.

blocks.en: We collect three datasets 𝒟 E ​ C i \mathcal{D}_{EC}^{i} , one for each of three participants providing input signals. Details of this data collection and EMG featurization are provided in the Appendix ( VI-B ). We independently train SmolVLA on each of these datasets, as well as the unaugmented form of the first dataset as a baseline. We then evaluate the models on the target task, as well as on a cluttered variation. We refer to the models tuned on EMG data and generic text as an electrophysiology-conditioned VLA, or EC-VLA. Figure 2 shows examples of observation images, including a cluttered scene, as well as the range of gestures provided by a participant.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了3个数据集 D E C i\ mathcal{D}_{EC}^{i},3个参与者各提供1个输入信号. 附录(VI-B.)详细介绍了这一数据收集和环境管理小组的特点。 我们独立地在这些数据集上训练SmolVLA,以及第一个数据集作为基线的未强化形式. 然后,我们评价目标任务的模型,以及复杂的变化。 我们把基于环境管理小组数据和通用文本的模型称为一种具有电生理学条件的VLA或EC-VLA。 图2显示了观测图像的例子,包括一个杂乱的场景,以及参与者提供的手势范围。

blocks.en: III-A 2 EC-VLA Evaluation
blocks.zh: EC-VLA 评价

blocks.en: The above procedures result in four models: three participant-specific EC-VLA models and one baseline. We evaluate each on 30 trials, consisting of 20 in-distribution (uncluttered) trials and 10 cluttered trials in which additional objects have been added to the workspace. During evaluation inference, continuous EMG data is provided by the corresponding participant for each EC-VLA model. As described above, we collect metrics following a task completion score adapted from MolmoAct [ 7 ] in addition to success rate. See Table I .
blocks.zh: 上述程序产生了四个模式:三个专门针对参与者的EC-VLA模式和一个基线。 我们分别对30起审判进行评估,其中包括20起分配(未集中)审判和10起在工作空间中添加了更多物体的审判。 在评价推断期间,每个EC-VLA模型的对应参与者都提供持续的环境管理小组数据。 如上所述,除了成功率之外,我们收集根据Molmo Act [7] 调整的任务完成分数的衡量标准。 见表一。

blocks.en: III-B Experiment 2: Visual-Annotation VLA
blocks.zh: III-B实验2:视觉-注释VLA

blocks.en: III-B 1 VA-VLA Tasks and Datasets
blocks.zh: III-B 1 VA-VLA 任务和数据集

A baseline descriptive prompt ℓ \ell describes which object should be picked and where it should be placed, such as ”Pick up the apple and place it on the plate on the counter.” , while ℓ u \ell^{u} is simply the constant ”Pick the object and place it.” , regardless of task. For a complete list of the 16 tasks, please see the per-task performance results in the appendix.

blocks.en: III-B 2 VA-VLA Evaluation
blocks.zh: III-B 2 VA-VLA 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate both models on all 16 tasks individually for 50 randomized episodes (800 episodes in total). As in EC-VLA above, we gather partial success criteria as well as overall success rates (explained in Table I ). The baseline model is given descriptive text while the visual-annotation model is given underspecified text and altered visuals that highlight objects based on segmentation masks.
blocks.zh: 我们为所有16个任务单独评价了50个随机化的节目(共800集)的两个模型. 与上面的欧共体-VLA一样,我们收集了部分成功标准和总体成功率(见表一)。 基准模型被赋予描述性文字,而视觉-注释模型则被赋予了不精确的文字和被修改的视觉,以分解口罩来突出物体.

blocks.en: We also run these same trials in eight modified tasks that include three additional random objects initialized near the target object. These “cluttered” tasks were selected because they have space available to spawn additional objects. Tasks that initialize a target object in a tight space (such as in a container or an appliance) were not tested in a cluttered configuration.
blocks.zh: 我们还在八个经过修改的任务中进行同样的试验,其中包括在目标对象附近初始化的另外三个随机对象. 这些“杂乱无章”的任务之所以被选中,是因为它们有空间来生产更多的物体。 在紧凑的空间中初始化目标对象的任务(如在容器或电器中)没有通过拼接的配置进行测试.

blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: We find broadly that our continuous conditioning signals result in better performance compared to a descriptive text prompt. This increase is marginal in a typical setting (a few percent), but more substantial in cluttered scenes. A full breakdown of our results, including partial task completion values, is provided in Table II . We also provide a visual in Figure 3 depicting the portion of trials that reach a particular stage in our scoring systems.
blocks.zh: 我们广泛认为,与描述性文字提示相比,我们的连续调节信号能产生更好的性能。 这一增长在典型情况下是微不足道的(少数),但在杂乱无章的场景中则更为显著。 表二提供了包括部分任务完成值在内的全部结果细目。 我们还在图3中提供了一幅图像,描绘在我们评分系统中达到某一阶段的试验部分。

These include failure (red), stage 1 partial credit (yellow), stage 2 partial credit (light green), and success (dark green). The black lines show changes in task completion score, which is an aggregate score of these behaviors. EC-VLA values are averages of all three participant models, and VA-VLA values are only taken from the tasks that can add clutter. (C) denotes cluttered trials

blocks.en: IV-A EC-VLA Results
blocks.zh: EC-VLA 结果

blocks.en: The EC-VLA models achieved a higher mean task score on the SO-101 cube picking task than the tuned baseline model, especially in cluttered trials (Table II ). While the success rate remained constant in the standard trials, the EC-VLA models provided an increase of 20% success rate in the cluttered case. There was a drastic decrease in complete failure rate, the portion of trials which do not achieve even stage 1 credit. For the baseline model, 50% of cluttered trials did not touch the target cube, while the EC-VLA model reduced this number to only 6%. The most common failure mode in this experiment corresponded to correct target identification but unsuccessful grasp execution. We examined the ability of each participant model to recover from such failed grasps, which is provided with other participant-model details in the appendix (Section VI-C ).
blocks.zh: EC-VLA模型在SO-101立方体选取任务上取得了比调制基准模型更高的平均任务分数,特别是在杂乱试验中(表二.). 虽然在标准审判中成功率保持不变,但欧盟-VLA模式在复杂案件中的成功率提高了20%。 完全失败率急剧下降,这部分审判甚至达不到第一阶段的信贷。 对于基线模型,50%的复杂试验没有触及到目标立方体,而EC-VLA模型则将这一数字减少到了6%. 这个实验中最常见的故障模式对应的是纠正了目标识别,但未能把握执行. 我们审查了每个参与者模式从这种失败的把握中恢复的能力,附录中提供了其他参与者模式的细节(第六节-C节)。

blocks.en: IV-B VA-VLA Results
blocks.zh: IV-B VA-VLA 结果

blocks.en: Our VA-VLA model generally achieves better performance in the RoboCasa pick-and-place tasks than the tuned baseline π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} model using a full text description. As in the EC-VLA results, this is especially true in the cluttered trials (Table II ). The most substantial difference between the models is in the complete failure rate of the cluttered setting. While the baseline model fails to even move the target object on 47% of cluttered trials, the VA-VLA model reduces this to 25%. These trials seem to be mixed in how much progress they make beyond this point, some only managing to lift the object while others completing the task. We note that numbers here are averaged across tasks, and these trends do not hold for every task individually. However, all tasks saw an increase in performance in cluttered scenes when comparing VA-VLA against the baseline. We provide complete success rate and partial credits scores for each task in the appendix (Tables III and IV ).
blocks.zh: 我们的VA-VLA模型在RoboCasa取地任务中一般能比使用完整文字描述的调制基线 0.5\pi=0.5}模型实现更好的性能. 与《欧洲反暴力法》的结果一样,在错综复杂的审判中尤其如此(表二)。 模型之间最实质性的区别在于杂乱布局的完全故障率. 虽然基线模型甚至未能将目标对象移动到47%的杂乱试验上,但VA-VLA模型将其降低到25%. 这些试验似乎有好有坏,因为它们超越了这一点,取得了多少进展,有些只设法抬起物体,而另一些则完成了任务。 我们注意到,这里的数字是各项任务的平均数,而且这些趋势并不分别适用于每一项任务。 然而,在将VA-VLA与基线进行比较时,所有任务在杂乱的场景中的表现都有所增加。 我们为附录中的每项任务提供完全的成功率和部分入分(表三和四)。

blocks.en: V Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 五. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: In experiments considering continuous EMG signals and visual annotations as alternatives to fixed language descriptions, we showed that VLAs can be specialized to receive task guidance from non-language modalities that provide task details instead of full text descriptions. We find minor increases in performance for in-distribution scenes with few objects, and strong increases in performance when testing in out-of-distribution scenes with ambiguity or clutter. This indicates that, while language may be important for learning latent representations in model pretraining, it may be less important as a task descriptor for downstream policies.
blocks.zh: 在考虑将连续的环境管理小组信号和可视化说明作为固定语言描述的替代品的实验中,我们表明,甚低频可专门接受非语言模式的任务指导,这些模式提供任务细节而不是全文描述。 我们发现分配中场景的性能略有提高,对象很少,在分配外场景中进行模糊或杂乱的测试时,性能也明显提高. 这表明,虽然语言对学习模式预训中的潜在表述可能很重要,但作为下游政策的任务说明,语言可能不那么重要。

blocks.en: In addition to data modality, a major change to the baseline in our experiments is that we provide updated conditioning at each state. In experiment 1, we have a human participant supervise policy execution and provide real-time guidance via EMG. In experiment 2, we exploit segmentation abilities from the simulator and provide updated visual annotations that highlight objects of interest. Future work should examine how much guidance is truly needed, and account for possible degradation when the system is deployed with new users or a secondary system to track and segment objects. Also considered should be blending modalities further, using whichever is most convenient for a user or most informative for the policy.
blocks.zh: 除了数据模式外,我们实验中基准的一大变化是,我们在每个州提供最新的条件。 在试验1中,我们有一名人类参与者监督政策的执行,并通过环境管理小组提供实时指导。 在实验2中,我们利用模拟器的分解能力,提供最新的视觉说明来突出感兴趣的对象. 今后的工作应审查真正需要多少指导,并在系统与新用户或二级系统相接以跟踪和分解物体时说明可能退化的情况。 还应进一步考虑混合方式,以用户最方便或政策信息最丰富的为准。

blocks.en: In the EC-VLA experiments, tuning of SmolVLA is conducted with LeRobot [ 21 ] . We tune the action expert and state projection while keeping the backbone frozen. We tune the model for 40k updates, using a batch size of 64, and generate a sequence of 50 actions conditioned on a single observation. We use the AdamW [ 22 ] optimizer with a learning rate of 1e-4 that cosine-decays to 2.5e-6 over 30k steps, a weight decay of 1e-10, and clip gradient norms to 10.0.

blocks.en: VI-B EC-VLA Data Collection
blocks.zh: 欧共体-VLA 数据收集

blocks.en: To compile demonstrations that include EMG observations, we collect fine-tuning data from three participants under an Institutional Review Board-approved protocol. A participant sits before the SO-101 tabletop setup, and an 8-channel Myo armband EMG (Thalmic Labs, Kitchener, ON, Canada) is placed on the proximal forearm, which is cleaned with isopropyl. During data collection, a separate human operator controls the robot via a leader arm using verbal cues from the participant and without knowledge of which cube was the target. As the participant provides cues, they simultaneously record intent via wrist gestures: flexion (left), extension (right), and relaxation (selection). This results in teleoperated trajectories that have corresponding EMG data to be treated as state information. Each participant provided 105 demonstrations with balanced target locations.
blocks.zh: 为了汇编包括环境管理小组观测结果在内的示范材料,我们根据机构审查委员会核准的议定书,从三个参与者那里收集微调数据。 一名参与者坐落在SO-101平面布置前,用异丙醇清洗的近缘前臂上放置了8道Myo臂带EMG(Thalmic Labs, Kitchener, ON, Canada). 在数据收集过程中,一个单独的人类操作员通过一个领头臂使用参与者的口头提示来控制机器人,而不知道哪个立方体是目标. 由于参与者提供了提示,他们同时通过手腕手势记录意向:弹性(左)、扩展(右)和放松(选择)。 这导致了电传运行的轨迹,这些轨迹具有相应的EMG数据作为状态信息处理. 每位与会者提供了105个具有均衡目标地点的演示。

blocks.en: To express the EMG signals as features, the 8-channel EMG signals are rectified and low-pass filtered (at 2Hz) to obtain signal envelopes. Taking the current envelope value for each signal at a given time results in an 8-dimensional state vector that can be concatenated with the existing 6-dimension proprioception vector, creating q E ​ C q_{EC} .
blocks.zh: 为了将EMG信号表现为特性,8道EMG信号被修正并被低通滤取(在2Hz)来得到信号信封. 在特定时间取出每个信号的当前信封值,会产生一个可与现有的6-二聚自旋向量相接的8维状态向量,生成q E C qQQEC}.

blocks.en: VI-C EC-VLA Participant Models and Recovery Analysis
blocks.zh: EC-VLA 参与模式和恢复分析

blocks.en: We found performance to be very similar among the three participant-specific EC-VLA models in terms of task completion score, as visualized in Figure 4 A. We also recorded how often each model attempted to recover from failed grasps, and found that participants would attempt corrections more often than the base model. Number of correction attempts were varied among participants, although critically all participants had some successful corrections. The base model, by comparison, never successfully recovered. This analysis is visualized in Figure 4 B.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,在任务完成分数方面,三个参与者特有的EC-VLA模型的表现非常相近,如图4A所示。 我们还记录了每个模式试图从失败的把握中恢复的频率,发现参与者会比基准模式更频繁地尝试更正. 与会者的更正尝试次数各有不同,但关键的是,所有参与者都有一些成功的更正。 相比而言,基础模型从未成功恢复. 这一分析可视化于图4 B.

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Details of performance for each participant EC-VLA model. A: partial scoring chart for each model compared with the baseline, showing score 0 (Failure, red), score 0.5 (Stage 1, orange), score 0.75 (Stage 2, light green), and score 1.0 (Success, dark green). B: analysis of how often each model attempted to recover from a failed grasp, and whether those attempts were successful.
blocks.zh: 发相. 4: 每位参与者EC-VLA模型的性能细节. A:每个模型与基准比较的部分分数图,显示分数为0(失败,红色),分数为0.5(第1步,橙色),分数为0.75(第2步,浅绿色),分数为1.0(成功,深绿色). B:分析每种模式如何经常试图从失败的把握中恢复,以及这些尝试是否成功。

In VA-VLA (center), the text is generic and the left and right cameras have visual annotations for the target object (green) and destination (blue).
